name: Youth Innovation Program (WIOA In-School Youth)
what_you_do: Help getting into college, jobs and work-based learning like internships and apprenticeships, with mentoring and support services.
grades: Currently in high school or college
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 21, currently in high school or college. Alameda County program. No income or residency rule is listed on the page.
pay_detail: Not stated. The youth page mentions paid and unpaid work experience but gives no wage.
how_to_apply: Contact a regional provider: Eden Area ROP in Hayward, (510) 293-2900, or Tri-Valley ROP in Livermore, (925) 487-4153. Main ACWDB line: (510) 259-3842.
notes: Out-of-school youth ages 16 to 24 use the Future Force program instead: La Familia (Eden Area) (925) 935-2643, Ohlone College (Tri Cities) (510) 742-2323, International Rescue Committee (North Cities) (510) 857-6884. The county page names only two providers, Eden ROP (Hayward) and Tri-Valley ROP (Livermore), and says to contact the one near you.
